links.comparator_used: Standard ChatGPT-4 prompt with no reading-level instruction (and existing patient education websites)
links.outcome: Readability indices (grade level required for comprehension)
links.effect: Almost all readability indices showed standard ChatGPT-4 responses demanded a higher educational level, whereas simplified (sixth-grade prompt) responses required a lower level of education than the existing websites. Simplified responses matched almost all existing websites on preference, accuracy and comprehensiveness.
links.tradeoff: Simplified responses were not preferred over standard ones; standard responses were preferred and rated more comprehensive by specialists, with simplified responses only matching websites on these measures.
links.quote: Notably, almost all readability indices suggested that standard ChatGPT-4 responses demand a higher educational level for comprehension, whereas simplified responses required lower level of education compared with the existing websites.
